SELECT wi.* FROM wms_inventory wi LEFT JOIN base_item bi ON bi.item_id = wi.item_id LEFT JOIN wms_location wl ON wl.location_id = wi.location_id
AND bi.item_code LIKE concat('%', #{itemCode}, '%')
AND bi.item_name LIKE concat('%', #{itemName}, '%')
AND wl.location_name LIKE concat('%', #{warehouseName}, '%')
ORDER BY wi.update_time DESC
